services.name: Guided Fly Fishing
services.desc: The Thompson Region was not coined the “Stillwater Fishing Capital of North America” by accident. With over 100 lakes accessible within an hour’s drive, our options are endless from the moment we leave the downtown core. Kamloops and its surrounding area are blessed with shallow, nutrient-rich lakes that allow rainbow trout to grow incredibly large, quickly. Reaching weights exceeding 10lbs, the multiple strains of Rainbow Trout found in the Thompson Region offer what is often referred to as the best fighting stillwater fish on the planet.
